Hello, my name is Alicia Jimenez and I am a philosophy professor from Mexico City, Mexico.

I believe in internalism when it comes to mental content. This means that I think mental states derive their content solely from factors internal to the individual's mind and are not dependent on external factors. I am very interested in studying the philosophy of mind and enjoy debating this topic with my colleagues. In my free time I like to read, travel, and spend time with my family.  (A) internalism
